# Kvasir

> Kvasir is a decentralized AI inference network (DePIN) in devnet preview. It runs open models that are larger than any single machine serving them: the source-available **p4** engine cuts a model into layer windows, and each device — GPU, CPU or phone — holds only its own window and hands a hidden state to the next. Step-3.7-Flash, 428B parameters, serves this way at 6.7–6.8 tokens a second. Contributors earn the **KVR** devnet token for measured compute.

Key facts (accurate as of 2026-09-21):

- **Kvasir** = the network/product brand (self-custody wallet + settlement gateway + node-reward network). **p4** = the source-available engine it runs on (Business Source License 1.1), on the `p4` branch of the repository below. **linkcpp** = the previous engine, superseded by p4 in mid-2026; results attributed to it are labelled as such. **KVR** = the token (on-chain name "Kvasir", 6 decimals, Solana **devnet** only).
- **Ring topology:** every device stores the same model and loads only its contiguous layer window, opening one link to its predecessor and one to its successor. Hidden-state boundaries circulate around the ring; the last node returns the token. There is no central master on the data path; placement comes from a plan an operator loads.
- **Rewards** are for measured compute. Roles: **compute node** (per contribution unit ≈ 1k tokens × layer share × performance tier S/A/B/C = ×1.5/×1.25/×1.0/×0.7), **gateway host** and **bridge host** (hourly uptime; the gateway also gets an inference bonus). Roles stack; rewards are paid in KVR to each node owner's wallet.
- **Contributors:** a device joins by proving a wallet, not by being let in. `POST /api/auth/challenge {"wallet"}` returns a nonce and a message; signing it and posting to `/api/auth/node-token` returns a 30-day bearer token scoped to participation and nothing else. With that token `GET /api/expert-demand` says which layers are short. Both are open on the gateway today — no operator approval, no minimum balance, no stake. A headless Linux node does all of this for you: `curl -fsSL https://pub-3fa7c08233cd497dbd39f89a9093c965.r2.dev/node/install.sh | sh`, then see [Run a node](https://kvasir-ai.net/run-node).
- **Developers:** OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible gateway (`/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/models`, `/anthropic/v1/messages`, `/anthropic/v1/models`). The Anthropic surface is non-streaming for now and says so if asked to stream; `/v1/responses` is not implemented, and an unimplemented API path answers a JSON 404 naming what does exist. Two ways to pay: pay-per-call (sign an on-chain KVR payment per request, no API key) or prepaid credits with an API key that an AI agent can self-issue from a wallet secret — see [llms-full.txt](https://kvasir-ai.net/llms-full.txt) and https://kvasir-ai.net/docs/api.
- **Compliance:** KVR is a devnet utility / contribution token — not a tradable mainnet asset, price, or investment, and nothing on the site is a promise of financial return. Wallet keys stay on the user's device; on devnet, staked KVR and prepaid credits are held by the gateway treasury until an on-chain staking program ships.
- **Serving today:** Step-3.7-Flash, a 428B MoE (45 layers, 288 experts per layer, top-8, Q4_K_XL), placed as 2 stages across two NVIDIA GB10 machines.
- **Also measured:** a 122B model (Qwen3.5-122B-A10B) served end to end across 3 physical machines — a GB10 and two Mac M4 Pros — with a phone holding part of it; cosine similarity ≥ 0.9999 across ROCm, CUDA and a phone CPU. GLM-5.2 (744B MoE) was verified on **linkcpp**, the previous engine, and that report is not published yet. Kimi K3 (2.8T MoE) on p4 is the next gate.
- **Live as of 2026-09-21:** the settlement gateway is ported to p4 and answering at `gate.kvasir-ai.net`. A paid request crosses the gateway, the bridge and the GB10 ring and is billed on the tokens it actually used. `/v1/models` answers **401** without a key — that is the gateway working, not an outage. Measured on the serving ring on 2026-10-01: Step-3.7-Flash (428B MoE) across two stages at **6.7–6.8 tok/s** single stream, **67–71 ms** to first token.
- **Retired:** `hub.kvasir-ai.net`. The control plane behind it was deleted, the bridge (`p4bridge`) took over its role, and a device now reaches it through the gateway. The DNS record was removed on 2026-09-21, so the host no longer resolves at all. If you hold a cached reference to it, drop it.
- **In flight right now:** hardening the ring through recovery gates after an interrupted 64-request run; turning the desktop client into a node that supervises a p4 agent; and carrying expert-grain sharding onto p4 — the market and the relays that let a phone join are live, the shard download and the engine-side dispatch are not. NPU support is in progress.
- **Terms & privacy:** https://kvasir-ai.net/legal
- **Name origin:** in Norse myth, Kvasir was formed from the pooled essence of all the gods and was the wisest being; his blood became the Mead of Poetry, sharing wisdom with all.
- **Languages:** the homepage is available in English, 한국어, 中文, Español, 日本語, Français, Deutsch, Nederlands and Bahasa Indonesia.

## Links

- [Homepage](https://kvasir-ai.net/): the full marketing site (all sections).
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/louisevandan/kvasir-net): the source-available engine (BSL 1.1); the `p4` branch holds the distributed inference engine.
- [Release notes](https://kvasir-ai.net/releases): what shipped, when, and the evidence for it.
- [Gateway](https://gate.kvasir-ai.net): OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible inference gateway (devnet), live. `/v1/models` answers 401 without a key — that is the gateway working, not an outage.
- [Agent instructions — use the inference API](https://kvasir-ai.net/llms-api.txt): for an agent doing it on someone's behalf — wallet, API key, first call, errors.
- [Agent instructions — run a node](https://kvasir-ai.net/llms-node.txt): for an agent doing it on someone's behalf — install, key, budget, worker, confirmation.
- [Run a node](https://kvasir-ai.net/run-node): how a device joins — desktop app, mobile, or a headless Linux server installed with one command.
- [Installing the mobile builds](https://kvasir-ai.net/install): how to install the Android package and how to build and sign the iOS app for your own device.
- [Terms & privacy](https://kvasir-ai.net/legal)
- [Full text for LLMs](https://kvasir-ai.net/llms-full.txt): the complete site content as plain text.
